title: The Seal Hunters
text: Hunters on the ice, wrapped in furs, clubbing seals by a breathing hole until the snow is red. They have a fire going in a ring of bones. They offer to share it. They keep glancing at the dark beyond the light.

options.label: Share their fire in the ring of bones.

outcomes.text: Warm, fed, and full of their stories, and none of you look at the dark either.

options.label: The shrewdest trades for their furs.

outcomes.text: Good furs, thick and warm, that turn the cold like armor.

options.label: The Leader asks what else hunts the ice.

outcomes.text: They tell you, and where, and they stop glancing at the dark only when they are done.
